name: status-collector
unmodelled: Marked Prey and Tally Ten (L5 +4 per distinct own status, cap +48) are conditional on the count; the file puts the 12-status value (+48 L5) and Crowded Ledger plus art-tag more (L2 +50) flat on the cash-in art's x from t = 0, and the basic attack gets neither, so the count is assumed full whenever the art fires and the basic attack's count bonus (real, in the game) is left out
Tally Gourd echo statuses (Qi Disruption, Bleed, Exposed) and the two further curses are not applied; only the six element debuffs are, so the simulator's count is 6 and the file credits 12
The enabler's 30 percent cut on status-applying arts is modelled as c_art 0.7 on the applicators
Curses other than Withering and Stagnation, conditions and guards, triggers, and the Opening Cut Bleed are not modelled
